verdict.rationale: Railway is a cloud platform with built-in AI features such as the Railway Agent and cloud agents, so a training-data privacy control is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack contains no training opt-out, no data-usage policy, and no statement that customer data is excluded from model training. Bring Your Own Models only changes which model account runs the agent, and 'files stay on the agent's disk' concerns storage location; both are adjacent features, not a training-prevention control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
